-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "POST /login Login(ctx, unmarshalForm(body))" -}}<p>{{- .Result -}}</p>{{- end -}}
{{- define "POST /query Query(ctx, unmarshalForm(body))" -}}<p>{{- .Result -}}</p>{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"fmt"
	"html/template"
	"net/url"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type LoginForm struct {
	Username string `name:"user-name"`
	Attempts int    `name:"attempts"`
}

type T struct{}

func (T) Login(_ context.Context, f LoginForm) (string, error) {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", f.Username, f.Attempts), nil
}

func (T) Query(_ context.Context, v url.Values) (string, error) {
	return v.Get("q"), nil
}
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, T{})

	postForm := func(t *testing.T, target string, form url.Values) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
		t.Helper()
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, target, strings.NewReader(form.Encode()))
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		return rec
	}

	t.Run("struct fields bind by name tag", func(t *testing.T) {
		rec := postForm(t, "/login", url.Values{"user-name": []string{"ada"}, "attempts": []string{"2"}})
		if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
			t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusOK)
		}
		if want := "<p>ada:2</p>"; rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})

	t.Run("typed field with a bad value is 400", func(t *testing.T) {
		rec := postForm(t, "/login", url.Values{"user-name": []string{"ada"}, "attempts": []string{"lots"}})
		if rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
			t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusBadRequest)
		}
	})

	t.Run("url.Values binds the whole form", func(t *testing.T) {
		rec := postForm(t, "/query", url.Values{"q": []string{"muxt"}})
		if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
			t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusOK)
		}
		if want := "<p>muxt</p>"; rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})
}
